A:
Original small HUD glyph concept. Square image, one centered glyph only, outer bounds within 15-85% of the canvas, uniform solid background #061623. Style: flat printed board-game token language. Die-cut silhouette, constant-width hairline edge, flat print,
bold flat glyph. Three tones per element: body, edge, glyph; an outer dark keyline only where the element lies on the
board. No gradients, no highlights, no bevels, no embossing, no textures, no drop shadows, no glow, no lens effects,
no stone, no parchment, no metal, no bronze. No brush strokes, no ink splatter, no paint splash anywhere.
Shape is the first channel, colour is the third: every state must stay readable in grayscale. Family: mouse cursor, 32 px. Meaning: this element is clickable. Glyph: a flat pointing hand, index finger up and to the left, the fingertip is the hot spot. Must stay clear at 24, 32 and 48 px. Colours: body #FAF8F2, keyline #111317 (2 px at 32 px), ring #F9EBDB. No lettering, no numbers. Forbidden: copying or imitating pixels, assets, splash art, logos, card text or fonts of any commercial digital
edition of a board game; brush-stroke banners and ink splatter; invented game data (card names, numbers, hero
names, HP, boards, spaces); text, letters or numbers baked into textures; red fills; any element on screen that
carries meaning only by colour.
